effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Vemmon] in its text among them to the hand, and place 1 [Vemmon] among them as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Vemmon] in its text, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
